name: one-for-all-nalanda-challenge
description: Root orchestration scripts for the service/ (Gradle) and sdk/ (npm) artifacts. Not a publishable package.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names infra,service,sdk --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run docker:up" "npm run dev:service" "npm run dev:sdk"
scripts.build: npm run build:service && npm run build:sdk
scripts.test: npm run test:service && npm run test:sdk
